cohort: The study included 220 pregnant women attending an outpatient department for antenatal care.
finding: The study found a 6.8% prevalence of magnesium deficiency among antenatal women, with 20% of women with hypomagnesemia developing preeclampsia, and 19% of women with normal magnesium developing preeclampsia and 17% developing preterm labor.
cross-section timing: Serum magnesium levels were determined at 24-26 weeks of pregnancy
